nodes.name: WhatsApp Inbound Webhook
nodes.notes: Receives inbound WhatsApp messages via Twilio/Meta Cloud API webhook. Configure your WhatsApp provider to POST to this URL.

nodes.name: Send WhatsApp Welcome
nodes.notes: Uses Twilio. Replace with Meta Cloud API if preferred. Set TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID and TWILIO_WHATSAPP_NUMBER in n8n variables.

nodes.name: Log Lead to Google Sheets
nodes.notes: Logs every new lead. Set LEADS_SHEET_ID in n8n variables. Sheet must have columns: Date, WhatsApp Number, Name, Message, Interest, Status, Converted, Follow Up Sent, Source

parameters.name: Body
parameters.value: Hey {{ $('Parse Message & Detect Intent').item.json.name }}! 💕 Just checking back in — did you get a chance to look at our collection? We have some stunning pieces right now and would love to sort you out 😍\n\nReply anytime to order or ask questions. We're always here! 🌸

nodes.name: Daily 8am Trigger
nodes.notes: Runs every day at 8:00am. Adjust timezone in n8n settings to Africa/Lagos.

nodes.name: Fetch Today's Content
nodes.notes: Reads rows from Content Calendar sheet where Scheduled Date = today AND Status = Scheduled. Required columns: Scheduled Date, Platform, Caption, Image URL, Hashtags, Status, Posted At

nodes.name: Schedule on Buffer (Instagram)
nodes.notes: Posts to Instagram via Buffer API. Set BUFFER_INSTAGRAM_PROFILE_ID in n8n variables. Get Buffer access token from buffer.com/developers.

nodes.name: Schedule on Buffer (TikTok)
nodes.notes: Posts TikTok via Buffer. Set BUFFER_TIKTOK_PROFILE_ID in n8n variables.

nodes.name: Send WhatsApp Status/Broadcast
nodes.notes: Sends to WhatsApp broadcast. For full broadcast list, loop through BROADCAST_SHEET and send to each contact.

parameters.subject: ✅ Tams Daily Posts — {{ $today.format('DD MMM YYYY') }}
parameters.message: HI, Daily summary of today's business

nodes.name: Email Daily Summary to Owner
nodes.notes: Sends a daily recap email to the owner. Set OWNER_EMAIL in n8n variables.

parameters.subject: 📅 Tams — No Posts Scheduled for Today ({{ $today.format('DD MMM YYYY') }})

nodes.name: Instagram Follower Webhook
nodes.notes: Receives new follower events. Connect via Meta Webhooks (subscribe to 'follow' events on your Instagram Business account) or via Phantombuster's Instagram Follow Monitor.

nodes.name: Send Welcome DM (Instagram)
nodes.notes: Sends Instagram DM via Meta Graph API. Requires Instagram Business account with messaging enabled. Set INSTAGRAM_PAGE_ACCESS_TOKEN in variables.

nodes.name: Watch for New Confirmed Orders
nodes.notes: Polls Orders sheet every minute for rows with Status=Confirmed AND Confirmation Sent=No. Required columns: Order ID, Customer Name, WhatsApp Number, Items Ordered, Total Amount, Status, Delivery Date, Confirmation Sent, Review Requested, Referral Sent

nodes.name: Wait 2 Days (Post-Delivery)
nodes.notes: Waits 2 days after order confirmation before sending satisfaction check-in.

parameters.name: Body
parameters.value:
Hi {{ $('Build Confirmation Message').item.json.name }}! 💕 We hope you're absolutely loving your {{ $('Build Confirmation Message').item.json.items }}! 😍

We'd love to see how you're rocking it — send us a photo and we'll feature you on our page! 📸

Also, a quick review goes a long way for a small business like ours 🙏 Just reply with a few words about your experience 💓

Thank you for being a Tams Beauty Hub babe! 🌸

nodes.name: Wait 7 More Days
nodes.notes: Waits another 7 days before sending the referral offer.

parameters.name: Body
parameters.value:
Hey {{ $('Build Confirmation Message').item.json.name }}! 🌸 Quick one — do you know anyone who would love Tams Beauty Hub?

💰 *Refer a Friend & Earn:*
Send your friend to us and when they buy, you both get a special discount:
• You get ₦500 off your next order
• Your friend gets a first-timer bonus

Just tell your friend to mention your name when they message us! That's it 💕

Thank you for being part of the Tams family! 💓

nodes.name: Add to Broadcast List
nodes.notes: Automatically adds every confirmed customer to the VIP broadcast list.

nodes.name: Every Sunday 9pm
nodes.notes: Runs every Sunday at 9pm WAT. Set timezone to Africa/Lagos in n8n settings.

nodes.name: Fetch Instagram Followers
nodes.notes: Gets current Instagram follower count via Meta Graph API.

nodes.name: Fetch Instagram Insights
nodes.notes: Gets weekly reach, impressions, and profile views.

nodes.name: Save Metrics to Analytics Sheet
nodes.notes: Builds a running history of weekly metrics for trend analysis. Set ANALYTICS_SHEET_ID in n8n variables.

nodes.name: New Customer Webhook
nodes.notes: Triggered when a new customer is added — either via Google Sheets update from Workflow 04, or manually called when you add a customer. Can also be triggered from a form or other automation.

parameters.name: Body
parameters.value:
Hey {{ $('Parse & Validate Customer').item.json.firstName }}! 🎉 You're now officially on our *VIP Broadcast List*! 👑

As a VIP you'll get:
✅ Early access to new arrivals
✅ Exclusive flash sale prices
✅ New nail design previews first
✅ Birthday specials 🎂

We'll never spam you — only the good stuff 💕

Thank you for shopping with *Tams Beauty Hub*! 🌸

nodes.name: Update Order Count (Repeat Customer)
nodes.notes: If customer is already on the list, just update their order count.

nodes.name: Monday Morning Broadcast Trigger
nodes.notes: Secondary trigger: sends a weekly broadcast to the entire VIP list every Monday at 10am.

nodes.name: Get This Week's Broadcast Message
nodes.notes: Fetches the weekly broadcast message from the Content Calendar sheet. Add a 'Broadcast Messages' tab with columns: Scheduled Date, Message, Type (promo/arrival/tip)

nodes.name: Send to Each Subscriber
nodes.notes: Processes one subscriber at a time to avoid rate limiting.

nodes.name: Rate Limit Delay
nodes.notes: 1 second delay between messages to stay within Twilio rate limits.
